fields.description: The opaque docname series. The branch's name is not the primary key, because a society that renames a branch would otherwise be unable to without breaking every link to it.
fields.label: Series

fields.description: What this place is called, in the society's own words, as it will appear on the map and in the list beside it.
fields.label: Name

fields.description: Which part of the society this place belongs to. Required at creation, and a Link rather than typed text, so a location is placed in the same hierarchy as everything else and a coordinator sees the ones in their own area without anybody maintaining a second list of what belongs to whom.
fields.label: Geo Node

fields.description: Whether this place appears on the public map. The whole of the guest-read rule for this doctype, the same way is_public on a content surface is the whole of the rule there: putting an office on the public map is a decision somebody makes on this form, not a condition written into a source file. Unticked ships nothing, which is the right default for an address.
fields.label: Show On Public Map

fields.description: A photograph of the place, so somebody looking for it recognises it when they arrive. Optional, and no image ships as a default: an empty slot is drawn as an empty slot rather than as a stock photograph of somebody else's building.
fields.label: Photo

fields.description: The street address as somebody would write it on an envelope. Free text, deliberately: address formats differ by country and a structured set of fields that suited one society would be wrong for the next.
fields.label: Address

fields.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, between -90 and 90. Optional: a branch that knows its address but not its coordinates is still worth listing, and it appears in the list beside the map without a pin on it rather than being refused.
fields.label: Latitude

fields.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, between -180 and 180. Given with the latitude or not at all: half a coordinate cannot be drawn anywhere, and a point on the equator off the coast of Africa is where half of them would land.
fields.label: Longitude

fields.description: A telephone number for the place. Not validated against a pattern here: the society's own phone format lives in core's settings and applies to a person's number, and an office switchboard is not a person.
fields.label: Phone

fields.description: An address for enquiries. The place's own, never a member of staff's: this is published, and a personal mailbox on a public page outlives whoever held it.
fields.label: Email

fields.description: When somebody can turn up, in the society's own words. Free text rather than a week of time fields, because what a visitor needs to read is one line and what a society needs to express is sometimes not a schedule at all.
fields.label: Opening Hours

fields.description: Anything else a coordinator wants recorded about this place. Internal: it is not served to the public map, so directions for staff and access notes can go here without being published.
fields.label: Notes
